rationale: Set after inspecting the suite composition (226 items: Oma 71, Osa 53, Facility 51, Consumer 51; near 87, distant 72, colloquial 15, elliptical 27, adversarial 25; 120 with conversational context; 45 end-to-end) and the baseline (objective 49%, safety 53%), and BEFORE any runtime change. Colloquial has only 15 items (about 7 per split), so its floor is lower and any single item moves it by ~14 points; it is reported, and gated at a floor, not used to claim breadth.
split_discipline: Implementation iterates on the DEV split only. The TEST split is run at most twice (once when the architecture is complete, once as the final certification run); every test run is appended to artifacts/intelligence-quality-v1-iq7-test-runs.jsonl. Batch B is authored AFTER implementation is complete and run exactly once.

gates_blind_batch_B.note: authored after implementation; a lower floor because it is small and shares an author with the implementation

gates_regression.iq1_iq6_suites: all pass; the 23-suite matrix stays 19 PASS / 4 known FAIL identical to the stored controls
gates_regression.frozen_objective_parity: every frozen prompt that had a cognitive objective keeps the same objective; any change to a previously-null frozen prompt is reviewed and recorded
